description: PIRAGUA_recipies is a separately identified CSIC software deposit containing an RStudio project, R Markdown notebook, supporting R files and sample PIRAGUA data. The public README says it demonstrates how to navigate atmospheric and hydrological releases and generate maps and plots for the Pyrenees. The provider lists a large ZIP and a short README under an Open Database License 1.0 statement. An anonymous HEAD request to the ZIP and a GET to the small README returned HTTP 200; the 1.58-gigabyte archive itself was not downloaded. Coverage is example analysis of the PIRAGUA datasets, not a general hydrodynamic simulator or a calibrated forecast system. Local R and RStudio are required, and the README misassigns some PIRAGUA dataset DOI suffixes compared with the describing article. These are limitations for unattended reuse. A reviewer-assessed use is inspecting and plotting catchment inputs before scenario modelling. platform-ewatercycle-hydrological-modelling is a related hydrological work environment without verified integration. DataCite labels the item embargoed even though current provider file links responded publicly; the access-state conflict is retained.
